name: worker-basic
note: A representative Worker task: read two files in one message (the contiguous read-only group), say nothing to end the loop, then pass validation. Chosen because it is the shortest path that touches all three phases — executing, validating, and the return value — without a server, a rollback, or a failing command.
provenance: authored to represent the shape of a recorded run; no provider key was available when it was written. Re-record with `node --test test/replay-worker.test.mjs --record` and an OPENCODE_API_KEY, then diff `expect` — any difference is a behaviour change, not a fixture update.

task.title: Read the module and prove it imports
task.description: The module under test must be importable before the change.
